body.text:
Started — with the spec-first step your question rightly pushed for. Summary of what just happened:

**The gap was real**: the plan had the review app as an approved *direction* (§2.2's four functions and SPA-before-Electron), but nothing buildable. So I wrote [architecture/REVIEW_UI.md](architecture/REVIEW_UI.md) (committed `9f3d73b`), which pins the decisions the plan left open:

- **Where it lives**: a new `packages/review-ui` (Vite + React) that builds to static assets and *never* imports `core` — it only talks to a JSON API. This is deliberately the shared-UI package MONOREPO_PLAN always anticipated: the desktop app later wraps this exact build in Electron, and the hosted version is this same SPA behind auth.
- **How it's served**: `git for-ai review` in the CLI over Node's built-in HTTP — no new server framework for a localhost viewer. Strictly `127.0.0.1`, read-only GETs, zero external requests, and the same non-minting-reads guarantee `report` proved: viewing the UI leaves every ref byte-identical.
- **The API is thin by design**: endpoints wrap the already-tested structured results from `report` and `show` rather than inventing new data assembly — so the UI inherits their honest-degradation behavior for free.
- **v1 scope**: timeline with filters, change detail (reasoning-first — I explicitly deferred diff rendering to v2 rather than half-build it), the session-trace narrative, a minimal attention queue (inferred/orphan identities, no-intent commits, low confidence), and a visibly-disabled ask panel until M12 lands.

**The build agent is now running** against that spec, in parallel with the M11 query-engine agent (they touch disjoint packages), under your RAM rule. Its definition of done includes actually serving this repo's real data and proving the ref-identity guarantee before it reports.

So shortly you'll have two things converging: `git for-ai review` opening a live browsable version of your report page, and the query engine that will later light up its ask panel. I'll verify and commit each as they land.

M11 landed with a strong report — RRF fusion, read-only blame identity, never-throwing synthesis with a keyless fallback, 31 new tests. Verifying independently before commit; the synthesis module (API-key handling) is the one I want to read personally:

attributes.command: cd C:/src/git-for-ai/packages/core && pnpm build 2>&1 | tail -2 && pnpm vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests |failed"

cd C:/src/git-for-ai && grep -n "apiKey\|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\|x-api-key" packages/core/src/query/synthesis.ts | head -12 && grep -n "catch\|skippedReason" packages/core/src/query/synthesis.ts | head -12

cd C:/src/git-for-ai && git add packages/core/src/query packages/core/src/index.ts && git commit -q -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
M11: query engine - hybrid retrieval, enrichment, blame, synthesis

packages/core/src/query implements CLI_PLAN M11 for M12's ask and
blame --why:

- retrieval.ts: query embedding -> vec0 KNN + FTS5 bm25, merged by
  reciprocal-rank fusion (incommensurable scores; rank fusion needs no
  calibration and rewards dual-half confirmation), kind filtering, and
  blame-position boosting sized so a line-covering chunk outranks a
  dual-half rank-1 hit. Voyage path embeds queries with
  inputType "query".
- enrich.ts: joins hits back to git truth (change-map with fold
  redirects, effective ledger entry across full history, session
  record) with a strictly read-only resolver - retrieval never mints
  identity, same discipline as log/show.
- blame.ts: real git blame --porcelain line attribution plus the §9.1
  "later touched by" scan.
- synthesis.ts: Anthropic Messages API via injectable fetch (no SDK
  dep, matching the Voyage precedent), default model claude-haiku-4-5
  (overridable per-call/env), numbered-source prompts with [n]
  citations parsed back to sources. Never throws: no key, non-2xx,
  network error, refusal all degrade to synthesized:false with a
  skippedReason - fully-offline ask stays useful (ranked raw sources).
- engine.ts: askQuestion + explainLine compositions; blame synthesis
  is opt-in since §9.1's output is a template over the ledger entry.

31 new tests (synthetic-vector store + bag-of-words fake embedder;
mocked HTTP for synthesis - the sanctioned mock; real fixtures through
real write paths for blame). Core suite: 237 passing, independently
re-verified. Real-model and live-API paths intentionally untested
here; first ask dogfood after M12 verifies end-to-end.

Flagged for later: factory.ts could grow an inputType option
(worked around in query/); enrichment is O(all changes) per call -
fine at dogfood scale.

Implemented by a background Fable 5 agent; reviewed (synthesis key
handling and failure paths read personally) and committed by the
orchestrating session.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -1

summary: claude-code session: 5 tool execution(s), 2 model turn(s) for commit "M11: query engine - hybrid retrieval, enrichment, blame, synthesis".
